Instrument (EN): Readiness for Therapy Questionnaire — six-item UK adult psychotherapy intake form
Scales / measured domains (EN): Readiness/motivation for change in psychological therapy; one brief pre-treatment total measure. No independently established diagnostic factors or robust sensitivity/specificity.
Research provenance: Ghomi M, Wrightman M, Ghaemian A, Grey N, Pickup T, Richardson T. Behavioural and Cognitive Psychotherapy 2021;49(4):413–425, first online 2020-11-17, DOI 10.1017/S1352465820000764. Initially 12 items, retained 6; 349 adult UK NHS psychological-service patients. Pre-therapy score associated with completion and PHQ-9/GAD-7 change, but ROC sensitivity and specificity were poor.

Other translations: No verified independent psychometric translation in other languages; original UK English study only.
Target population: 349 adults in UK NHS psychological therapy service for common mental-health difficulties (study 69.6% women, 90.5% White). Recruitment and outcomes do not establish use as a general intake suitability or psychiatric diagnostic screen.

Instrument (EN): Adherence to Refills and Medications Scale — original US 12-item chronic-disease measure
Scales / measured domains (EN): Adherence to medication-taking behaviours (8 items); prescription-refill behaviours (4 items); overall self-reported adherence, with lower score indicating better adherence. Refill subscale alpha .641 in original study.
Research provenance: Kripalani S et al. Value in Health 2009;12(1):118–123, first online 2009-01-23, DOI 10.1111/j.1524-4733.2008.00400.x. Final 12 items from 14 tested in 435 US patients with coronary heart disease; two factors, total Cronbach alpha .814, adequate internal consistency in literacy strata. PhenX 2022 protocol #331001 documents precise licensing restrictions.
DB locales: No exact original ARMS-12 family in prior 3939-key Master, 11 registered, original PR495 reference CSV or Supabase published definitions; do not confuse with A-DES or CAARMS acronyms.
EN form: Original English-language US respondent form; US chronic-disease validation in N435. No additional independently validated English language translation inferred.
RU form: No original-source RU respondent validation verified in this cycle.
ES form: PhenX lists a downloadable Spanish worksheet, NOT sufficient evidence of an independently validated ES questionnaire nor permission to translate/modify; ES respondent validation not confirmed in this cycle.
Other translations: PhenX additionally provides Chinese-language worksheet download; language availability is NOT proof of psychometric validation nor permission to translate. No separate additional language validation confirmed in this cycle.
Target population: 435 mostly older US coronary heart disease patients in an inner-city primary-care setting, including lower health literacy. No automatic generalization to psychiatric medication adherence or other national populations.

Instrument (EN): Traditional Health Practices for Cervical Cancer Prevention Scale — Haitian Creole 11-item U.S. migrant cohort
Scales / measured domains (EN): Single factor: self-reported traditional health practices and culturally situated beliefs relevant to cervical-cancer prevention. Not eleven subscales; not cancer risk, disease diagnosis, or psychotherapy diagnostic measure.
Research provenance: Guillaume D et al. Psycho-Oncology 2026;35(3):e70433, first online 2026-03-19, DOI 10.1002/pon.70433. Initial 30 Haitian Creole items from formative interviews, expert review and factor reduction to 11 items; N151 Haitian women recently migrated to USA. One factor, Cronbach alpha .79; exploratory preliminary study, no independent replication shown.
